# Frontier Trails

> Rental of a fully kitted retro 4x4 overlander with a rooftop tent, from Barcelona, Spain, for self-drive soft-road trips into Spain's backcountry: mountains, desert, outback, volcanoes, gorges and wild coast. Founded by Tom. A work in progress: the first trips are planned for spring 2027, and there is a waitlist for early access.

## What you get
- A retro 4x4 overlander with a rooftop tent that goes up in two minutes. Two people sleep in the rooftop tent; the car seats five; extra tents on request.
- A camp kitchen, a safety kit, and a route scouted by hand and checked against park and camping rules. The route is a suggestion: follow it or ignore it.
- Soft-road driving only: gravel, forest tracks and quiet mountain roads. No 4x4 experience needed.
- Price: from €180 a day.
- Pickup: in the Barcelona area. Airport pick-up on request.
- Licence: a standard driving licence. Drivers from outside the EU may need an International Driving Permit.
- Support: available on WhatsApp, with 24/7 roadside assistance.

## The six landscapes (all within reach of Barcelona)
- [The Pyrenees](https://www.frontiertrails.es/the-frontier/pyrenees/): the high mountains. Hiking, via ferrata, climbing, mountain biking.
- [Bardenas Reales](https://www.frontiertrails.es/the-frontier/bardenas-reales/): the desert, in Navarra. Stargazing, gravel tracks, photography.
- [Los Monegros](https://www.frontiertrails.es/the-frontier/monegros/): the outback, in Aragón. Gravel tracks, stargazing.
- [La Garrotxa](https://www.frontiertrails.es/the-frontier/garrotxa/): volcanoes and forests, in Catalonia. Hiking, mountain biking.
- [Sierra de Guara](https://www.frontiertrails.es/the-frontier/sierra-de-guara/): gorges and rivers, in Aragón. Canyoning, kayaking, hiking.
- [Cap de Creus](https://www.frontiertrails.es/the-frontier/cap-de-creus/): the wild coast, Costa Brava. Kayaking, snorkelling, coastal hikes.
